children: Scholar Rock announced FDA approval of ISEMBYLD for SMA patients on SMN2-targeted therapy and confirmed plans to meet FDA post‑marketing requirements.
FDA approved ISEMBYLD (apitegromab-mstn) for treating spinal muscular atrophy in patients ≥2 years on SMN2-targeted treatment.
Management misstated during an investor call that no post‑marketing safety commitments were required; that was incorrect.
FDA requires a pregnancy safety study to collect and analyze pregnancy and birth outcomes for exposed pregnancies; Scholar Rock will conduct it.
FDA requested 15‑day "alert reports" for all serious and non‑serious fracture cases; the company intends to submit such reports.
